request.subject: The Real Rocky Lost to Muhammad Ali - part 3: From Losing Fighter to Best Picture
request.title: The Real Rocky Lost to Muhammad Ali (Part 3/3)
request.description:
Stallone watched Wepner lose to Ali, then wrote Rocky in days. Did Wepner deserve credit for the ultimate underdog story?

Part 3 of 3: The Real Rocky Lost to Muhammad Ali

Sources:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad_Ali_vs._Chuck_Wepner
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chuck_Wepner
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rocky

Stock footage: Pexels. Made with AI-assisted narration.

#shorts #truestory

extra_params.video_script: Rocky's script was written right after Wepner lost. In Part 2, Wepner lasted until the final round before the referee stopped it. Sylvester Stallone, then a little-known actor, had watched it. He later said Wepner seemed to have no chance. Soon after, Stallone wrote Rocky in less than four days. Unlike Wepner, his underdog goes the distance. Rocky won Best Picture. Stallone at first denied Wepner was the inspiration, but later admitted it. Wepner sued him in 2003, and they settled out of court. He lost the title fight, but inspired the ultimate underdog. Subscribe for a new true story every day.
